video.title: They Had More HATS Than Songs | KTS Von & KTS Dre 'Demon Brothers'
video.caveat: Narration of unverified street claims and allegations, not confirmed facts.

1.summary: Per the video, Ziko, a cousin of KTS Von and KTS Dre, was shot and killed during an altercation in a McDonald's parking lot. The narrator says the shooter fled the city and was arrested in Indianapolis. 051 began repping "Ziko World" in his honor.

2.summary: The video says tension between Lakeside and the smaller Moskegan Boys boiled over when MBG general G. Faso was shot. MBG began repping "Faso Land," and the killing pushed Moskegan to click up with No Limit, forming NLMB.

3.reliability: listed as unconfirmed; alleged per street rumor
3.summary: Described as KTS/Lakeside's first alleged killing. Gotti was shot while sitting in a parked car with a friend who was not in a gang. His set renamed itself "Gotti World"; KTS mocked the death with "Don't go Gotti" shirts.

4.summary: Drive-by on a crowd outside a liquor store in No Limit territory. Rock and Alamo were killed and five people were wounded, including G Herbo, G Pharaoh and Lil Wet. The corner became known as "Rock Block."

5.reliability: disputed; tried but acquitted, no conviction
5.summary: Big Los, an NLMB OG, was shot from behind as he returned to his porch with coffee and a newspaper. The video frames it as retaliation after a KTS member was hit. Two people were tried and acquitted; a third person later confessed and then recanted.

6.summary: Less than two weeks after Big Los, Bud, a young Lakeside member the video says was raised in the hood by KTS Dre, was shot multiple times on the sidewalk by four shooters in the afternoon.

7.summary: Not a shooting. Per the video, Ronnie Mo and two teens fled police after a break-in; the car crashed into a tree on icy streets. Ronnie Mo and Andre Keredine died at the scene and Shedan Gibbs died later. Included for completeness.

8.alleged_group: No Limit (suspect named; charge did not stick)
8.summary: Lo was ambushed by two shooters around 6 p.m. while walking through his own hood; a companion was hit in the ankle and Lo in the stomach. Police arrested a No Limit member but the charge did not stick. The video says the ambulance broke down on the way to the hospital.

9.reliability: alleged only; no formal charge mentioned
9.summary: Pharaoh was shot in the alley while taking out the trash for his 82-year-old adoptive father. The video ties it to his dissing Ronnie Mo after the crash, and cites public social-media mockery of his death afterward.

10.reliability: alleged only; no legal outcome given
10.summary: Around 4 a.m., after a night shooting dice on 79th with G Herbo and others, Kobe declined a ride and was shot walking home, outside the same McDonald's seen in the "No Lackin" video. His death inspired G Herbo's "Balling Like I'm Kobe."

11.summary: Five days after getting out of jail, Posto was shot in a building hallway around the corner from his home and died at Northwestern that night. The video gives two theories: an NLMB hit, or an internal drug-deal dispute.

12.alleged_group: Disputed: NLMB, Circon City, EBC or Vice Lord OGs
12.summary: KTS Von was walking alone in the afternoon when two shooters got out of a car and shot him repeatedly. His final track, "Kill to Survive," had just been released. The narrator says the streets are split on who was responsible.

13.summary: A year after KTS Von's death, his father Big Vinnie was shot five times in a parked car in Park Manor; his 22-year-old daughter was hit three times and survived. The video says the shooter came from his own set and was identified by a witness and convicted.

14.alleged_group: KTS / Lakeside / Pocket Town (police prime suspect; no conviction)
14.reliability: named police suspect, uncharged per source
14.summary: Magic was standing outside a parked car when two cars pulled up and opened fire. He died at the hospital; two others in the car were wounded and survived. Per the video, police named a prime suspect but no conviction is mentioned.

15.summary: The video traces this to a tense encounter between Lil Greg and a Pocket Town member in a barbershop on South State Street. Only a getaway driver was reported charged, on weapons counts rather than homicide.

16.summary: Pocket Town gathered on the block for a birthday remembrance of a member who had died a year earlier; the gathering was ambushed. Two people were wounded and survived; Killer Spook was killed.

17.summary: Minutes after bonding out of Cook County Jail, KTS Dre was walking with his mother and a street activist when masked shooters from two waiting cars opened fire outside the jail. The case remains officially unsolved.
